452632.overview:
A port (demake?) of the GBA port of the flash game Quartet, a fast paced puzzle game where you assemble faces to score.
Rules:
• Assemble faces with 4 pieces
• Full faces are worth more
• If you try to move a piece to a occupied space you lose a life
• If the timer runs out you also lose a life
• Try and clear the board for an extra life (5 Max)
